about: Match music round 4 (2026-10-22), from the operator's round-3 review. Two kinds of keep landed. "Battle in costume": one distinctive non-battle genre played as a fight (the operator: "hellfire tango and aero djent felt like battle music which made them fun"); generic battle (hard rock, heavy riff boost) was only maybe, and genre-stacked heroics (power metal, violin metalcore, string djent) were no. "A place you are in": the operator: "council hall was very immersive"; its music was written as heard from the far end of a hall and laid 7 dB under a murmuring room bed, while organ and humming chorale over the same bed at +8 to +10 dB were no. RG (empty) and RW (maybes only) get two of each. Every prompt asks for a warm, soft-topped mix (no and maybe takes carried about twice the 2-6 kHz share of keeps) and through-composed sections instead of round 3's shared five-tag skeleton with the theme twice ("too repetitive"). The 16-bit lane kept one take of 31, the abyssal sewer, a sparse place piece; three pilots try that recipe.
